title: Model Creation and Quantization
summary: This module handles the creation and quantization of machine learning models, primarily focusing on Safetensors models. It includes functionalities for converting models, applying various quantization techniques, and managing model configurations.

nodes.label: Validate Model Inputs
nodes.title: Validate Model Inputs
nodes.description: Ensures that the provided model directory and quantization options are valid before proceeding with model creation.

nodes.label: Create Safetensors Model
nodes.title: Create Safetensors Model
nodes.description: Core logic for processing Safetensors files, handling configuration, and preparing tensors for quantization or direct import.

nodes.label: Apply Quantization Techniques
nodes.title: Apply Quantization Techniques
nodes.description: Manages various quantization methods (e.g., int4, int8, nvfp4, mxfp8) and applies them to model tensors based on configuration or explicit requests.

nodes.label: Pack & Transform Tensors
nodes.title: Pack and Transform Tensors
nodes.description: Handles the packing of pre-quantized tensor triplets and performs transformations specific to certain model architectures like Qwen3.5.

nodes.label: Manage Model Manifest & Layers
nodes.title: Manage Model Manifest and Layers
nodes.description: Orchestrates the creation of model layers and the final manifest, ensuring all components are correctly referenced.

nodes.label: Laguna Model Quantization
nodes.title: Laguna Model Quantization
nodes.description: Applies specialized quantization rules for Laguna models, respecting source tensor precision and selectively quantizing routed experts.

groups.label: Model Input Handling
groups.title: Model Input Handling
groups.description: Handles initial validation and parsing of model files and configurations.

groups.label: Core Model Processing
groups.title: Core Model Processing
groups.description: Contains the central logic for reading, transforming, and preparing model tensors.

groups.label: Output Generation
groups.title: Output Generation
